title: Overtime Hearts
style: 1986 pop-metal arena rock anthem, gritty blue-collar male tenor vocal with a shouted high chorus, 122 BPM, D minor with a dramatic key change up for the final choruses, talk-box guitar hook that sounds like a robotic voice, pulsing sequenced synth bass, chugging palm-muted rhythm guitars opening into power chords, bright keyboard pads and synth brass, huge arena drums with gated reverb, fast melodic guitar solo, clap-and-chant breakdown, big male gang vocals, glossy wide mix, working-class love story, defiant, fist-pumping stadium singalong

Gritty male tenor with a blue-collar edge. Verses are sung low and tense, like telling a story across a bar. The chorus leaps up high and is shouted as much as sung, backed by a gang of voices on every 'oh-oh'. After the key change the lead is at the very top of his range, slightly cracking, which is the thrill.
